tools.description: Call this before paying the registration fee of a Bittensor subnet. tools.name: list_contests
tools.description: Call this when choosing which Bittensor subnet to enter. tools.name: check_wallet
tools.description: Call this to see how a wallet has done on Bittensor entry fees. Give the coldkey, which is the SS58 address that pays the fees, and it returns every entry that wallet made in the last 30 days with the fee paid, what came back, the result and whether the entry is still being paid.
